business_summary: Arta TechFin Corporation Limited, an investment holding company, provides financial services in Hong Kong. It operates through five segments: Global Markets Business, Asset Management Business, Insurance Brokerage Business, Investment business, and Wealth Management and Consultancy Services Business. The company is involved in securities and futures brokerage, and margin financing operations; placing in equity capital market and debt capital market, as well as underwriting services; and provision of advisory services for private structured finance transactions, mergers, and acquisitions. It also provides asset management products and services, including investment advisory, external asset management, portfolio management, fund incubation, and transaction execution services to professional and institutional investors. In addition, the company engages in insurance brokerage business; investments of low-risk and high liquidity investment portfolio and proprietary trading; and provision of wealth planning and related services. Further, it offers tailored and IT services, and various solutions to meet the needs of clients, including family offices, institutional investors, and ultra-high-net-worth families; and corporate finance advisory, consultancy, and money lending services. The company was formerly known as Freeman FinTech Corporation Limited and changed its name to Arta TechFin Corporation Limited in October 2021. Arta TechFin Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Arta TechFin Corporation Limited는 홍콩에서 금융 서비스를 제공합니다. 글로벌 시장 사업, 자산 관리 사업, 보험 중개 사업, 투자 사업, 자산 관리 및 컨설팅 서비스 사업 등 5개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 증권 및 선물 중개, 마진 금융 운영에 참여하고 있습니다. 자기자본 시장 및 타인자본 시장에 진출하고 인수 서비스를 제공합니다. 민간 구조화 금융 거래, 합병 및 인수에 대한 자문 서비스 제공. 또한 전문 및 기관 투자자에게 투자 자문, 외부 자산 관리, 포트폴리오 관리, 펀드 인큐베이션 및 거래 실행 서비스를 포함한 자산 관리 상품 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 보험중개업을 영위하고 있습니다. 저위험 및 고유동성 투자 포트폴리오 및 자기매매 투자; 자산 계획 및 관련 서비스 제공. 또한, 패밀리오피스, 기관투자자, 초고속기업 등 고객의 요구에 맞는 맞춤형 IT서비스와 다양한 솔루션을 제공하고 있습니다.
